body:
Imani (S008) claim for B-2026-09-11-1: make provider per-turn token usage
visible on the SSE wire.

Scope (behavior change, narrow):
1. backend/src/api/routes/chat.py — the `_event_stream` done branch builds
   `done_payload = {"type": "done"}` and drops `chunk.usage` entirely.
   Forward the turn's provider usage onto the done event (field
   `provider_usage`, same name the turn_complete obs event uses so the
   benchmark harness's `ev.get("provider_usage") or ev.get("usage")` reads
   it unchanged).
2. backend/src/core/agent_runtime.py — the two memory_op branches emit
   `turn_complete(provider_usage={})` and yield a bare done chunk with no
   usage; the zero-provider-call contract stays honest ({} means "no
   provider call", now explicitly), and the done chunks carry the same
   empty usage so the wire event exists with an honest payload.
3. tests — new regression tests pinning: done event carries provider_usage
   on the loop path; synthetic/canned turns carry no fabricated tokens;
   memory_op turns report zero-usage honestly.

NOT claimed: backend/src/core/agent/loop.py (Baraka/S005 holds it; the loop
already yields usage on done chunks — no edit needed there).

No ADR/behavior risk: additive wire field; frontend consumes what it wants.
Live-verification per the standing bar on isolated port 8765 (never 8000).
